# Supabase browser library

`supabase.js` is the unmodified UMD browser bundle of `@supabase/supabase-js` version **2.119.2**, downloaded from:

https://unpkg.com/@supabase/supabase-js@2.119.2/dist/umd/supabase.js

The MIT license is included in `SUPABASE-LICENSE`. Keeping the library here allows offline page loads without a CDN connection. Update the pinned version deliberately and test sign-in and session restoration after updating it.
